name: StaticNotification

props.name: actionButtonLabel
props.description: Pass in the action button label that will be rendered within the ActionableNotification.

props.name: caption
props.description: Provide a description for "close" icon button that can be read by screen readers / 'aria-label'?: string; /** Specify the caption

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Specify if pressing the escape key should close notifications

props.name: hasFocus
props.description: Specify if focus should be moved to the component on render. To meet the spec for alertdialog, this must always be true. If you're setting this to false, explore using Callout instead. https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon/pull/15532

props.name: hideCloseButton
props.description: Specify the close button should be disabled, or not

props.name: kind
props.description: Specify what state the notification represents

props.name: lowContrast
props.description: Specify whether you are using the low contrast variant of the ActionableNotification.

props.name: statusIconDescription
props.description: Provide a description for "status" icon that can be read by screen readers

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon StaticNotification rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
